purpose: Test whether regional radiometric conditioning adds value beyond the same trainable head supplied constant per-branch training descriptors, and beyond removing token augmentation.

constant_descriptor.unit: each valid crop equal weight, per coarse/fine branch separately
constant_descriptor.statistic: four-dimensional arithmetic mean accumulated in float64 then cast to float32
constant_descriptor.intervention: replace ONLY h_psi input; keep same network, prototypes, token scaling, original reliability inputs, gate, crop extraction and training
constant_descriptor.used_at: all training and evaluation calls; no evaluation-dependent statistics

initialization: All variants share exactly the same base initialization and minibatch ordering within each seed. Any constant buffers are fixed, initialized without RNG, and excluded when comparing active-parameter state hashes.

training.loss: original one-direction diagonal caption-to-image cross entropy; duplicate-image behavior unchanged
training.pair_order: frozen load_captions ordering: images in first-appearance order, then captions per image in original order, filtered to train IDs (not raw interleaved CSV row order)
training.shuffle: independent Python random.Random(seed) stream per run; in-place epoch shuffle of same starting pair order

splits.evaluation_query: one original first caption per image; full within-split gallery
splits.status: Both evaluation sets have been used historically and informed this question. This is exploratory mechanistic retraining, not unseen test validation.

forbidden_inputs: old fitted head as performance substitute or warm start

inference.unit: matched training seed, n=5; fixed datasets
report: family-wise95percent Bonferroni intervals over4primary contrasts: each98.75percent Student-t CI df4
inference.limitations: Small-sample normality approximation; not image-sampling or external generalization inference. Shared splits/contrasts are not independent replications. No p-value-driven model selection. Seeds0-2 conditional heads have previous anchor histories. These post hoc intervals are not preregistered confirmatory or distribution-free proof; n5 cannot validate normality.
inference.claim_requires: A named control comparison passes on BOTH evaluation sets. Failure means insufficient evidence under this rule, not proof of zero effect.

execution_rules: No configuration selection, hyperparameter sweep, early stopping, additional seeds or retrial based on metric sign.
Freeze all new source and exact input/source hashes after independent code review and meaningful tests but before first new training.
First run seed0 conditional as a compatibility anchor and require old corresponding head parameters and ranks to match; investigate implementation differences before other training.
Once anchored, complete all15heads and both evaluations, retain all results including negative values.
Do not load official test images, caches or captions.
No manuscript or public code changes in this diagnostic.
Do not infer independent fine-branch value: no A0 comparison in this study.
Further formal multi-backbone assessment is a separate decision, not automatically triggered by a favorable metric.
